title: Singularities in any Characteristic
summary: We give an overview of the fundamental definitions and results concerning hypersurface singularities, defined by convergent power series over an arbitrary real valued field. This approach combines, on the one hand, the classical case of analytic power series over the complex numbers with formal power series over arbitrary fields, but on the other hand, it goes significantly beyond that. Besides general definitions and basic results, we report on the classification of contact simple and right simple singularities in positive characteristic.
